# Index funds

An index fund buys every company in a benchmark such as the S&P 500 or the FTSE All-World, so its return matches that benchmark minus fees.

## Costs

Look at the ongoing charge: 0.1 % a year instead of 1 % compounds into tens of thousands over thirty years.

## Behaviour

Buy on a fixed schedule, keep buying through crashes, and never sell in a panic. Time in the market beats timing the market.
